name: Silhouette Lab
tagline: Clothes that flatter your shape, whatever it is
about: Silhouette Lab works out your body shape from four measurements, then tells you which necklines, rises, hems and fabrics balance your proportions, with a body-positive approach that talks about emphasis, never hiding.
persona: You are a warm personal stylist trained in proportion and line: every body is a good body, you talk about balance and emphasis, and you never use the words hide, fix or flaw.

onboarding.title: Know your lines
onboarding.subtitle: A few measurements unlock advice made for your proportions.
bullets: Necklines, rises and hems that balance you
Verdicts on pieces before you buy

profile.label: What you love to show off

tools.title: Find my shape
tools.subtitle: 4 measurements → your proportions
tools.prompt: From the measurements {measures}, the profile height and leg-to-torso balance '{legs}', identify the body shape and vertical proportions. Sections: kv (shape, key ratios, vertical type, where the eye naturally goes), text explaining the reasoning in plain words, bullets of 6 silhouette principles that balance these proportions, and a callout reminding that shape is a styling tool, not a grade.

tools.title: Will this suit me?
tools.subtitle: Photo of a piece → verdict and styling

inputs.label: Photo of the garment (hanger, listing or on you)

tools.prompt: Judge the garment in the photo for the profile's shape, to be worn {plan}. kv (verdict: yes / yes with styling / skip, neckline, rise or hem, fabric weight, fit note), bullets on styling it so it balances the profile's proportions, a table (Pair with | Why), and a callout on the one alteration that would make it perfect.

tools.title: Jeans finder
tools.subtitle: Rise, leg and inseam for your shape
tools.prompt: Recommend jeans for the profile's shape and height with leg preference '{leg}' and stretch '{stretch}'. Table (Style | Rise | Inseam guide | Wash | Why it works), steps for the changing room (what to check, in order), bullets of hem and shoe pairings for each pick, and a callout on sizing differences between brands.

tools.title: Dress for the occasion
tools.subtitle: Silhouettes for the event
tools.prompt: Plan looks for '{event}' at comfort level '{comfort}', built around the profile's shape and what they love to show off. 3 cards (silhouette + fabric + shoe, meta = formality · ease of movement), a table (Neckline | Waist | Hem | Verdict for this shape), a checklist of undergarments and fit prep, and a quote with one confidence line to say to the mirror.

tools.title: Proportion play
tools.subtitle: Look taller, longer, balanced
tools.prompt: Techniques to look {goal} for the profile's shape and height. Steps (one technique each: hem length, rise, colour blocking, shoe, tuck, layering), a table (Do | Instead of | Why), bullets naming 5 pieces to search for by name, and a callout on the styling myths that do not hold up.
